checks.name: transverse_count_positive
checks.source:
import S9Pilot.Madelung
open S9Pilot
noncomputable section
theorem domain_control :
    Module.finrank ℝ (transverseSpace (![0, 0, 1] : Vec)) = 2 := by
  have hk : (![0, 0, 1] : Vec) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h2 := congrFun h 2
    norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_two] at h2
  have hd := transverseSpace_finrank hk
  norm_num [hd]
